title: Catch-up time after a ten-minute worker outage
method: Synthetic arrivals are 200 messages/s. A 600-second processing outage creates 120,000 messages. Drain time = backlog / (processing capacity - arrival rate), then divide seconds by 60. Capacity assumptions exclude retries, overhead and downstream bottlenecks.
alt: Catch-up time after a ten-minute worker outage. Capacity 300 per second: 20 minutes to drain; Capacity 400 per second: 10 minutes to drain; Capacity 600 per second: 5 minutes to drain. Illustrative values.
